body: A charming anthropomorphic {{animal}} runs a tiny fish stall at a lively morning market. The animal wears a neatly tied apron and proudly presents a fresh fish on brown paper while a customer hand offers a few coins. Keep the animal facial features recognizable and the paws anatomically simple. Detailed wooden crates, soft morning sunlight, shallow depth of field, photorealistic textures with a whimsical storybook mood, no signs or lettering.

instructions.en: No reference image is needed. Copy the full prompt into your image generator.
instructions.zh-Hans: 无需参考图，将完整提示词复制到图像生成工具即可。

Change the animal while preserving the fish, customer hand and coins: these objects explain the interaction. Keep the paws simple.
